interpretation: Valid reduced-model scientific negative under the present scalar response closure: energy match passed at 2.0740273878777047e-16 relative mismatch, zero-field control was present, and both cases passed the unchanged +0.020% width / +0.10% Jpk gates, but segmentation degraded width, Jpk, and integrated high-J relative to the energy-matched unsegmented control and improved no principal metric. Inspection of the underlying reduced audit shows response metrics are computed from peak_abs_shear -> scalar transport multiplier -> scalar gain, so this rung cannot establish whether spatial shear-layer location/width/sign or moving E_r(r,z,t) structure is beneficial. Do not attribute benefit to segmentation, and do not interpret this as a native M3D-C1 electrode result.
claim_boundary: Reduced-model energy-matched segmentation comparison only. No native M3D-C1 electrode efficacy, experimental, reactor-scale, precursor, or species-separation claim.
